reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper with holidays and reuses RSchedule/recurConfigToRSchedule in the new handler, but the daily-skip rule is not put into a shared helper and is re-expressed at each consumer.

duplication.why: The daily-schedule skip (weekend-or-holiday check, detect daily, drop occurrence) is written separately in getNextDate (find over 7 occurrences) and getDatesInRange (null map + filter), and the isWeekend||isHoliday predicate is repeated outside the helper that already loops on it.

placement.why: Holiday matching and weekend moving live in shared/schedules.ts where the tree keeps that logic, but the daily-skip decision is split between shared getNextDate and the server handler instead of one shared definition.

scope.why: Edits are all about the four steps (helper, handler, type, parseRecurDate plumbing, tests); no unrelated changes.

maintainability.why: The weekend/holiday rule now has several partially consistent implementations: getUpcomingDates and the budget schedule-template still call the helper without holidays and without daily skip, and daily detection differs (rrule frequency vs config.frequency).

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts getDatesInRange isDaily branch and shared/schedules.ts getNextDate skipDailyWeekends branch decide weekend/holiday skipping outside getDateWithSkippedWeekend; schedule-template.ts and getUpcomingDates call it without holidays

disguised_duplication.where: daily weekend/holiday skip implemented as dates.find(!isSkippedDay) in getNextDate and as a map-to-null plus filter in getDatesInRange; same rule reshaped rather than shared

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; daily special cases added around it in getNextDate and getDatesInRange (both re-implement the weekend/holiday check); getUpcomingDates and the two schedule-template.ts call sites still bypass the new holiday/daily rules
